[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Zehlon Reach northwestern village.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = Northwestern village | pic3 = [[Image:Zehlon Reach northern docking platform.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = Northern docking platform | ingame name=Zehlon Reach | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=483 }} [[Zehlon Reach]] is a large swampy area that dominates much of the central northern shore of the island of [[Istan]]. There is a large fishing village towards the northwestern corner of this area and a small docking platform towards the northern center. The docking platform appears to be used by [[corsair]]s and seems to be maintained by a shady trader. In the southeastern portion of Zehlon Reach, there are some old ruins of what appears to be several ancient buildings. ==Getting there== Zehlon Reach is situated to the northeast of [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]]. The [[primary quest]] that will first bring a character here is [[the Honorable General]]. Watch their levels before attacking if your party is still at a low level. *The eastern half of the area has many Skale Blighters capable of spreading [[Disease]]. Consider [[Condition removal]] or [[Health Regeneration]] skills. *Approaching the small island with corpses (to the east of the village) will [[spawn]] 4 [[Corsair]]s. *There are hidden [[Mandragor]]s in several locations: northwest of [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)]], north of [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] exit, and the central [[Plant]]-infested area. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.1% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 243|low = 222|high = 264}} **If approached, Suspicious Hermit turns hostile once his dialogue runs out. It is easy to leave the area before he becomes fully hostile and not notice.
